profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer and lifelong learner who recently made the switch from a career in Audio Engineering and Live Event Production. I’m also a board game and video game enthusiast. I have a passion for dissecting, understanding, and refining complex systems, whether they are game rulesets, audiovisual systems, or software codebases.

positions.title: Software Engineer & Consultant
positions.description:
* Designed large scale interventions aimed at improving knowledge flow at the National University of Colombia, La Paz. Developed a knowledge flow framework to model the University and provide transparency and explainability.
* Worked on bugs and features of the Opportunity Landscape Toolkit product, an API integration tool for Google services and proprietary datasets. Also provided resources and solutions for a variety of problems and design decisions, ranging from UX to game design.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineering Program
positions.description:
Was part of the first ML Engineering cohort at FourthBrain. 

PulseAudio, Real Time Speech Enhancement - Capstone (PyTorch, AWS)
* Built and trained a deep learning model for speech enhancement and denoising.
* Deployed to GCP using a Flask backend.

positions.title: Audio Engineer
positions.description: Audio engineer working front-of-house and monitor mixes for artists and events around Full Sail Campus and Winter Park, FL.

positions.title: Voice Actor and Audio Technician
positions.description: Voiced characters for various English as a Second Language courses, both in studio and remotely. Maintained and operated my own equipment while working remotely.

positions.title: Audio and Lighting Engineer
positions.locationName: Stage Left Studios, New York, New York
positions.description: Combination of both front-of-house audio engineer and lighting operator, working with the ETC family of lighting consoles.

positions.title: International Student Centre Volunteer
positions.description: Event Production and international community outreach.

positions.title: Studio Technician and Live Audio Engineer
positions.description: Studio Technician and Live Audio Engineer for artists managed by K30.

projects.title: PulseAudio - Real-time Speech Enhancement
projects.description: Real-time speech enhancement program using an encoder-decoder network around an LSTM.
